name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
beneficiaries: farmers, individual cultivators, tenant farmers, fishers, dairy farmers
benefit: Revolving credit limit for cultivation and allied activities with 7% interest rate, reduced to 4% per annum upon prompt repayment with interest subvention.
eligibility: Groups: farmers, individual cultivators
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare — KCC Portal

name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (KALIA, Odisha)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Empowerment
beneficiaries: small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural labourers, vulnerable agricultural households
benefit: Direct financial assistance of ₹4,000 per year for small and marginal farmers, and ₹12,500 one-time livelihood assistance for landless agricultural households.
eligibility: Groups: small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural labourers
source_name: Government of Odisha — KALIA Portal

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
beneficiaries: horticulture farmers, FPOs, entrepreneurs
benefit: Capital subsidy up to 40%–50% for polyhouses, shade nets, cold storage, post-harvest infrastructure, and nursery establishment.
eligibility: Groups: horticulture farmers, FPOs
source_name: MIDH National Portal

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
beneficiaries: farmers, traders, farmer producer organisations
benefit: Transparent price discovery through electronic bidding, assaying facilities, access to buyers nationwide, and direct digital settlement into farmer accounts.
eligibility: Groups: farmers, traders
source_name: e-NAM Official Portal

name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
beneficiaries: livestock farmers, individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs
benefit: Capital subsidy up to 50% (up to ₹50 lakh for poultry, ₹50 lakh for sheep/goat breeding farms, and ₹30 lakh for piggery farms).
eligibility: Groups: livestock farmers, individual entrepreneurs
source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying — NLM

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
beneficiaries: farmers, organic farming groups, farmer clusters
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years, of which ₹31,000 is directly provided for organic inputs, biological fertilizers, and seeds.
eligibility: Groups: farmers, organic farming groups
source_name: PGS-India Organic Certification Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
beneficiaries: farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers cultivating notified crops
benefit: Low actuarial premium rates (maximum 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops) with government subsidy covering the rest.
eligibility: Groups: farmers, sharecroppers
source_name: PMFBY National Crop Insurance Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
beneficiaries: farmers, landholding farmer families, small and marginal farmers
benefit: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 transferred directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
eligibility: Groups: farmers, landholding farmer families
source_name: PM-KISAN Official Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
beneficiaries: farmers, panchayats, cooperatives, farmer producer organisations
benefit: Central financial assistance of up to 30% of the benchmark cost (with matching state share) for standalone solar pumps (Component B) and solarization of agricultural pumps (Component C).
eligibility: Groups: farmers, panchayats
source_name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy — PM-KUSUM Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) — Per Drop More Crop
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
beneficiaries: farmers, small and marginal farmers, horticulturists
benefit: Capital subsidy up to 55% for small and marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers for installation of drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Groups: farmers, small and marginal farmers
source_name: PMKSY National Portal

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
beneficiaries: dairy farmers, livestock entrepreneurs, cooperatives
benefit: Subsidy up to 50% (maximum ₹2 crore) for establishment of breed multiplication farms, free artificial insemination services, and IVF lab assistance.
eligibility: Groups: dairy farmers, livestock entrepreneurs
source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying — Rashtriya Gokul Mission

name: Silk Samagra 2 (Integrated Silk Development Scheme)
beneficiaries: sericulturists, silkworm rearers, silk reelers
benefit: Financial assistance and technology support up to 50% for mulberry plantation, rearing appliances, silkworm seed production, and reeling units.
eligibility: Groups: sericulturists, silkworm rearers
source_name: Central Silk Board — Ministry of Textiles

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
beneficiaries: farmers, cultivators
benefit: Free soil test report issued every 3 years containing nutrient status (12 parameters: N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) and customized dosage guidance.
eligibility: Groups: farmers, cultivators
source_name: Soil Health Card National Portal

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
beneficiaries: farmers, custom hiring entrepreneurs, self-help groups, FPOs
benefit: Subsidy ranging from 40% to 50% on cost of farm equipment (tractors, power tillers, rotavators, harvesters), with higher incentives for women, SC, ST, and small farmers.
eligibility: Groups: farmers, custom hiring entrepreneurs
source_name: Direct Benefit Transfer in Agriculture Mechanization Portal

name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship)
abbreviation: Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
beneficiaries: rural entrepreneurs, agri-business startups, technical training institutions
benefit: One-time grant up to 100% of plant & machinery cost (max ₹1 crore) for government agencies and 50% (max ₹50 lakh) for private entities to establish Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs).
eligibility: Groups: rural entrepreneurs, agri-business startups
source_name: Ministry of MSME — ASPIRE Portal

name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs
benefit: 35% capital subsidy on project cost up to ₹35 lakh, and 6% interest subvention for the entire loan repayment period.
eligibility: Age: 18 to 55 yrs; Groups: Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs
source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — MSME Portal

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
beneficiaries: micro enterprises, small enterprises, startups, women-led MSMEs
benefit: Guarantees credit facilities up to ₹5 crore per borrowing unit without third-party guarantee or collateral security, with guarantee coverage ranging from 75% to 85%.
eligibility: Groups: micro enterprises, small enterprises
source_name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises — CGTMSE

name: MSME Champions Scheme (MSME Sustainable ZED Certification)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Quality Council of India / MSME Champions
beneficiaries: manufacturing MSMEs, Udyam registered enterprises
benefit: Subsidy on ZED certification cost: 80% for Micro, 60% for Small, and 50% for Medium enterprises, with an additional 10% subsidy for women, SC, and ST entrepreneurs.
eligibility: Groups: manufacturing MSMEs, Udyam registered enterprises
source_name: Ministry of MSME — Champions Portal

name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS, Tamil Nadu)
department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
beneficiaries: first generation entrepreneurs, educated youth, graduates and diploma holders
benefit: Capital subsidy of 25% of the project cost (up to ₹75 lakh) and 3% interest subvention during the entire tenure of the bank loan.
eligibility: Age: 21 to 35 yrs; Groups: first generation entrepreneurs, educated youth
source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — MSME Online Portal

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
beneficiaries: street vendors, hawkers, thelawalas, urban roadside sellers
benefit: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy on prompt repayment and cashback on digital transactions.
eligibility: Groups: street vendors, hawkers
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs — PM SVANidhi

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
beneficiaries: traditional artisans, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, carpenters, tailors, cobblers, weavers
benefit: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, basic skill training of 5–7 days with ₹500/day stipend, modern toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest, and digital transaction incentives.
eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: traditional artisans, blacksmiths
source_name: Ministry of MSME — PM Vishwakarma Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
beneficiaries: micro food processors, farmer producer organisations, self-help groups, producer cooperatives
benefit: Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 lakh per unit, seed capital of ₹40,000 per SHG member for working capital, and support for branding/marketing.
eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: micro food processors, farmer producer organisations
source_name: Ministry of Food Processing Industries — PMFME

name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme (PMFME)
beneficiaries: micro food-processing enterprises, self-help groups, farmer producer organisations, cooperatives
benefit: Component-specific credit-linked, training, infrastructure, seed-capital or marketing support where available under current guidelines.
eligibility: Groups: micro food-processing enterprises, self-help groups
source_name: Ministry of Food Processing Industries — PMFME portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
beneficiaries: small business owners, shopkeepers, artisans, micro manufacturing units, women entrepreneurs
benefit: Collateral-free loans across categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 lakh for previous repayers).
eligibility: Groups: small business owners, shopkeepers
source_name: Department of Financial Services — PMMY

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
beneficiaries: prospective entrepreneurs, unemployed youth, SHGs, cooperative societies
benefit: Margin money subsidy of 25% (general) to 35% (special categories including women, SC, ST, OBC, PwD, minorities, NER) of project cost up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for services.
eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: prospective entrepreneurs, unemployed youth
source_name: Khadi and Village Industries Commission — PMEGP e-Portal

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
beneficiaries: traditional artisans, khadi producers, coir clusters, artisan producer companies
benefit: Financial grant up to ₹2.5 crore for regular clusters (up to 500 artisans) and up to ₹5 crore for major clusters (more than 500 artisans) for Common Facility Centres (CFC), tools, and marketing.
eligibility: Groups: traditional artisans, khadi producers
source_name: Ministry of MSME — SFURTI Portal

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
beneficiaries: SC entrepreneurs, ST entrepreneurs, women entrepreneurs
benefit: Composite bank loan (including term loan and working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading.
eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: SC entrepreneurs, ST entrepreneurs
source_name: Department of Financial Services — Stand-Up India

name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP, Tamil Nadu)
department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
beneficiaries: unemployed youth, Class 8 pass youth
benefit: Subsidy of 25% of project cost (up to ₹2.5 lakh for manufacturing, ₹1.25 lakh for services, and ₹75,000 for business) with 7-day EDP training.
eligibility: Age: 18 to 35 yrs; Max income: Rs 500,000; Groups: unemployed youth, Class 8 pass youth
source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — UYEGP Portal

name: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances (ADIP)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
beneficiaries: persons with disabilities, Divyangjan, children with special needs
benefit: Free or subsidized aids and appliances (hearing aids, battery-operated tricycles, wheelchairs, smart canes, Daisy players, prosthetics, artificial limbs) up to ₹15,000 per beneficiary.
eligibility: Groups: persons with disabilities, Divyangjan
source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities — ADIP Scheme

name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
beneficiaries: children and adults with disabilities, special educators, rehabilitation NGOs
benefit: Grant-in-aid covering up to 90% of project cost for special schools for children with hearing, visual, or intellectual impairment, vocational training centres, and community-based rehabilitation.
eligibility: Groups: children and adults with disabilities, special educators
source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities — DDRS

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
beneficiaries: persons with severe or multiple disabilities, BPL persons with disabilities
benefit: Monthly central pension of ₹300 per month (increased to ₹500/month at age 80+) with supplementary state top-ups ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month.
eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: persons with severe or multiple disabilities, BPL persons with disabilities
source_name: NSAP Portal — IGNDPS

name: National Fellowship for Persons with Disabilities (NFPwD)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
beneficiaries: research scholars with disabilities, M.Phil and Ph.D students
benefit: Monthly fellowship of ₹37,000 (Junior Research Fellow) and ₹42,000 (Senior Research Fellow) plus annual contingency allowance, escort allowance, and HRA.
eligibility: Groups: research scholars with disabilities, M.Phil and Ph.D students
source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities — Fellowship

name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) Concessional Loans
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: National Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation (NDFDC)
beneficiaries: entrepreneurs with disabilities, PwD students, parents of persons with intellectual disabilities
benefit: Concessional term loans up to ₹50 lakh for self-employment enterprises and ₹20 lakh for education in India (₹40 lakh abroad) with interest rates ranging from 4% to 8% per annum.
eligibility: Age: 18 to 60 yrs; Groups: entrepreneurs with disabilities, PwD students
source_name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation

name: Scheme for Implementation of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act (SIPDA)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
beneficiaries: persons with physical disabilities, visually impaired citizens, elderly persons
benefit: Central grants to create accessible lifts, ramps, Braille signage, tactile paths in public buildings, government universities, hospitals, and accessible websites.
eligibility: Groups: persons with physical disabilities, visually impaired citizens
source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities — SIPDA

name: Tamil Nadu Maintenance Allowance for Differently Abled Persons
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
beneficiaries: persons with severe disabilities (75% and above), persons with intellectual disabilities, muscular dystrophy patients
benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500 (enhanced up to ₹2,000 for severely bedridden beneficiaries) disbursed directly through bank accounts.
eligibility: Groups: persons with severe disabilities (75% and above), persons with intellectual disabilities
source_name: Tamil Nadu Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Project
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
beneficiaries: all persons with disabilities, Divyangjan
benefit: Smart card based national identity (UDID card) accepted pan-India, removing the need to carry multiple medical certificates across departments and public transport systems.
eligibility: Groups: all persons with disabilities, Divyangjan
source_name: Unique Disability ID Official Portal

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
department: Maulana Azad Education Foundation / Ministry of Minority Affairs
beneficiaries: minority girl students, school students
benefit: ₹5,000 per annum for Classes IX and X; ₹6,000 per annum for Classes XI and XII.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 200,000; Groups: minority girl students, school students
source_name: National Scholarship Portal — Begum Hazrat Mahal

name: Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
department: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
beneficiaries: primary school students, children in Classes 1 to 5
benefit: Hot freshly prepared nutritious breakfast (such as upma, pongal, kichadi with vegetable sambar) on all school working days before classes begin.
eligibility: Groups: primary school students, children in Classes 1 to 5
source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu Official Portal

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region
beneficiaries: North Eastern Region students, undergraduate students
benefit: ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional courses for the entire course duration.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 450,000; Groups: North Eastern Region students, undergraduate students
source_name: National Scholarship Portal — UGC Ishan Uday

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
department: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
beneficiaries: girl students in higher education, female college students
benefit: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,000 directly transferred to the girl student's bank account until successful completion of undergraduate degree/diploma/ITI.
eligibility: Groups: girl students in higher education, female college students
source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — Pudhumai Penn Portal

name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students
beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe scholars, ST researchers, doctoral students
benefit: Fellowship of ₹37,000/month (JRF) / ₹42,000/month (SRF) plus contingency allowance, or full tuition fee reimbursement in top institutions.
eligibility: Groups: Scheduled Tribe scholars, ST researchers
source_name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs — Fellowship Portal

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
beneficiaries: students, secondary school students, economically weaker students
benefit: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for selected students studying in Classes IX to XII in government/aided schools.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 350,000; Groups: students, secondary school students
source_name: National Scholarship Portal — NMMSS

name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Candidates
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste scholars, postgraduate students, doctoral researchers
benefit: Full tuition fees, annual maintenance allowance (US$ 15,400 or £9,900), contingency allowance, visa fees, air passage, and medical insurance.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste scholars, postgraduate students
source_name: National Overseas Scholarship Online Portal

name: National Scholarship Portal — participating scholarships
beneficiaries: students
benefit: Scholarship benefits vary by listed scheme; consult the current academic-year listing.
eligibility: Groups: students
source_name: National Scholarship Portal

name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
beneficiaries: school children, primary students, upper primary students
benefit: Nutritious hot cooked meals every school day meeting prescribed calorie (450 kcal for primary, 700 kcal for upper primary) and protein norms.
eligibility: Groups: school children, primary students
source_name: PM POSHAN Official Portal

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
beneficiaries: college students, university students, undergraduate students
benefit: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three years of undergraduate studies and ₹20,000 per annum at post-graduate level.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 450,000; Groups: college students, university students
source_name: National Scholarship Portal — CSSS

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
beneficiaries: minority students, college students
benefit: Admission and tuition fee reimbursement up to ₹10,000/year plus maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 200,000; Groups: minority students, college students
source_name: Ministry of Minority Affairs — Scholarship Schemes

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste students, post-matric students
benefit: Full non-refundable compulsory course fee reimbursement plus monthly academic maintenance allowance (up to ₹13,500/year depending on course group).
eligibility: Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste students, post-matric students
source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — Post Matric SC

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe students, college students
benefit: Compulsory course fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance paid directly via DBT.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: Scheduled Tribe students, college students
source_name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs — Scholarship Schemes

name: Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
beneficiaries: female students, girl students in engineering and technology
benefit: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards tuition fee, computer purchase, books, and competitive exam preparation.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: female students, girl students in engineering and technology
source_name: National Scholarship Portal — AICTE Pragati

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Classes IX and X)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste school students, students in classes 9 and 10
benefit: Academic allowance of ₹3,500 per annum for day scholars and ₹7,000 per annum for hostellers studying in Classes IX and X.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste school students, students in classes 9 and 10
source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — Pre Matric SC

name: Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
beneficiaries: students with disabilities, technical education students
benefit: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study towards tuition fees and academic expenses.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: students with disabilities, technical education students
source_name: National Scholarship Portal — AICTE Saksham

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
beneficiaries: school students, elementary students, girl students
benefit: Free textbooks, free uniforms up to elementary level, transport allowance, Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas, and composite school grants.
eligibility: Groups: school students, elementary students
source_name: Ministry of Education — Samagra Shiksha

name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste students, premier institute students
benefit: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges, living expenses allowance of ₹3,000/month, book grant of ₹5,000/year, and one-time computer grant up to ₹45,000.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste students, premier institute students
source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — Top Class SC

name: Vidyalakshmi Education Loan Scheme
beneficiaries: students seeking education loans, higher education students
benefit: Single window platform to apply for education loans across scheduled commercial banks and claim full interest subsidy (CSIS) during the moratorium period for students with family income up to ₹4.5 lakh.
eligibility: Groups: students seeking education loans, higher education students
source_name: Ministry of Education — Vidyalakshmi Scheme

name: Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY)
beneficiaries: formal sector job seekers, re-employed workers who lost jobs during pandemic
benefit: Government subsidy of 24% of wages (both 12% employees' and 12% employers' EPF contributions) for establishments employing up to 1000 employees.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 180,000; Groups: formal sector job seekers, re-employed workers who lost jobs during pandemic
source_name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation — ABRY

name: Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS / ITI)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
beneficiaries: youth, Class 8, 10, and 12 school leavers, technical trainees
benefit: Industry-recognized National Trade Certificate (NTC) awarded by NCVT, free or nominal-fee practical workshop training, and campus placement support.
eligibility: Age: 14 to Any yrs; Groups: youth, Class 8, 10, and 12 school leavers
source_name: Directorate General of Training — CTS

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGA)
beneficiaries: rural adult citizens, rural unskilled workers, agricultural labourers, women workers
benefit: Guaranteed statutory wage employment for 100 days per household per year (with extra days in notified drought areas), with wages directly credited to bank/post office accounts.
eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: rural adult citizens, rural unskilled workers
source_name: Ministry of Rural Development — MGNREGA Portal

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
beneficiaries: vocational students, ITI passouts, graduates, diploma holders
benefit: Government sharing of 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice directly transferred via DBT to the apprentice's bank account.
eligibility: Age: 14 to Any yrs; Groups: vocational students, ITI passouts
source_name: Apprenticeship India Official Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
beneficiaries: unemployed youth, school and college dropouts, existing workers seeking upskilling
benefit: Free industry-aligned short term training (STT), Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), modern Industry 4.0 courses, assessment, government certification, and placement assistance.
eligibility: Age: 15 to 45 yrs; Groups: unemployed youth, school and college dropouts
source_name: PMKVY Official Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)
beneficiaries: new wage earners earning up to ₹15,000/month, formal sector workers
benefit: Government of India pays 12% of the employer's contribution towards EPF and EPS for new eligible employees for a period of 3 years.
eligibility: Max income: Rs 180,000; Groups: new wage earners earning up to ₹15,000/month, formal sector workers
source_name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation — PMRPY

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
beneficiaries: unorganised workers, domestic workers, street vendors, rickshaw pullers, construction workers
benefit: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹3,000 per month after attaining 60 years of age, with equal 50:50 matching contribution by the Government of India.
eligibility: Age: 18 to 40 yrs; Max income: Rs 180,000; Groups: unorganised workers, domestic workers
source_name: Ministry of Labour and Employment — PM-SYM

name: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI)
beneficiaries: rural unemployed youth, BPL youth, women entrepreneurs
benefit: Completely free short-term skill development training with free boarding and lodging, followed by two years of handholding and bank loan linkage for enterprise setup.
eligibility: Age: 18 to 45 yrs; Groups: rural unemployed youth, BPL youth
source_name: Ministry of Rural Development — RSETI

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka)
department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood
beneficiaries: unemployed graduates, unemployed diploma holders, youth residing in Karnataka
benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹3,000 for degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders for up to 2 years or until gainful employment is found.
eligibility: Groups: unemployed graduates, unemployed diploma holders
source_name: Government of Karnataka — Seva Sindhu

name: e-Shram Portal (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
beneficiaries: unorganised workers, migrant workers, gig and platform workers, street vendors, construction workers
benefit: Issuance of a 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) e-Shram card, accidental death/permanent disability cover of ₹2 lakh, and seamless linkage to central/state welfare schemes.
eligibility: Age: 16 to 59 yrs; Groups: unorganised workers, migrant workers
source_name: e-Shram National Database Portal

name: Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — Health & Family Welfare

eligibility: Groups: vulnerable families in Kerala, existing RSBY and Karunya beneficiaries

source_name: State Health Assurance Society — MJPJAY
